title: res.ok vs throw

blocks.md:
## 404 does not throw

The app stub answers `/missing` with status 404. `fetch` still resolves. `res.ok` is false. You throw *if you choose* after you look. A missing beacon list is still a response.

Print `ok` for `/beacons.json` and teach `read()` to throw when `!res.ok`. The desk got a slip back. The stamp says 404. That is not the same as the runner crashing.
